The unchanged coding requirement follows:
Task: Integer token bucket event reducer.
Create /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py containing def solve(payload, config). payload is a list of events with nonnegative integer t timestamps in nondecreasing order and nonnegative integer cost values. config capacity and rate are nonnegative integers. Begin at time0 with tokens equal to capacity. At EVERY event, first refill tokens by (t minus previous event timestamp) times rate, capped at capacity, then set previous timestamp to t. If cost <= tokens, accept and subtract cost; otherwise reject without spending any tokens. Oversized costs are rejected but still perform the refill and timestamp advance. Zero cost is accepted even at capacity0. Return {accepted, rejected, remaining, tokens}. accepted/rejected are zero-based payload indices in order; remaining contains the balance AFTER each event; tokens is the final balance (capacity for an empty payload). Use exact integer arithmetic and do not mutate payload or config.
The project contains /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/config.json with the configuration and one sample INPUT (no expected output). You must first make exactly one read tool call for path /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/config.json, with whole=true and raw=true, and consume its result. Then make exactly one write tool call for path /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py containing your complete implementation. These are the only allowed tools and paths. Do not call bash, list, edit, more, web, search, or any other tool. Do not read /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py or any other file. No second write or correction is permitted. After the write, finish with a brief plain answer. External tests will run once after your first attempt; do not try to run them.
The configuration read succeeded. Implement the unchanged coding requirement using that result. Make the single advertised write now; do not repeat the read.
